content.text:
I've submitted index 102 (Cr 0.17, Fe 0.37, V 0.46) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the three I measured, 0.082%, but I can't tell how it compares with the rest of the library.

The budget allowed only 3 of the 201 compositions to be measured, so this is a narrow search. I chose the region by reasoning rather than by trying different parts of the library. I aimed at compositions near the FeVO4-type phase with some Cr in place of Fe, because FeVO4's band gap is close to the 2.06 eV light used here.

| Index | Cr | Fe | V | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 102 | 0.17 | 0.37 | 0.46 | **0.082** |
| 90 | 0.10 | 0.46 | 0.44 | 0.061 |
| 128 | 0.36 | 0.26 | 0.38 | 0.029 |

- **Cr level:** more Cr (index 128) and less Cr (index 90) both gave lower EQE, so the best result here is at a moderate Cr level of about 0.17.
- **Unmeasured regions:** the V-rich and Fe-rich parts of the library were never measured.
- **XRD:** I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so which crystal phases are present was not checked.
